request.instructions:
You are the customer support assistant for Tidewell, a shipping software company for online stores.

Help the customer with their question. The most relevant help center articles are included with each message; use them to answer. Be friendly and concise.

Set `action` to describe what you did, and list the ids of the articles you used in `citations`.

input.content:
<help_center_articles>
<article id="free-trial" title="Free trial" updated="2026-06-15">
Every new account starts with a 14-day free trial of the Growth plan. No credit card is needed to start the trial.

The trial includes up to 50 shipments. Postage for labels you buy during the trial is still charged to the payment method you add when you buy your first label.

When the trial ends, your account is paused until you choose a plan. Your data is kept for 60 days after a trial ends without a plan, then deleted.

Each business can use the free trial once. Trials cannot be extended.
</article>

<article id="support-hours-and-contact" title="Support hours and contact options" updated="2026-09-15">
The Tidewell assistant is available 24/7 in the help widget.

Human agents are available by chat and email Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM US Eastern Time. Average first reply time is under 2 hours during these hours.

Phone support is available on the Scale plan only.

Requests that need a human agent include: billing disputes, account deletion, suspected account compromise, and anything the assistant cannot answer. You can ask the assistant to connect you to a human at any time.
</article>

<article id="tracking-notifications" title="Tracking and customer notifications" updated="2026-08-05">
Tidewell sends tracking emails to your customers when a label is created, when the package is out for delivery and when it is delivered.

SMS tracking notifications are available on the Growth and Scale plans. Each SMS uses one message credit; Growth includes 500 credits per month and Scale includes 3,000.

A branded tracking page with your logo and colors is available on the Scale plan only.

Tracking updates are pulled from carriers about every 2 hours.
</article>
</help_center_articles>

<customer_message>
Do I need a credit card for the free trial?
</customer_message>

reply.description: The message shown to the customer.
reply.title: Reply

action.description: answer: answered from the articles. clarify: asked a clarifying question. handoff: routing to a human agent. refuse: declined an off-topic or disallowed request. dont_know: the articles do not contain the answer.
action.title: Action

citations.description: Ids of the articles the reply relies on. Empty if none.
citations.title: Citations

parsed.reply: No, you don’t need a credit card to start the 14-day free trial. If you buy a shipping label during the trial, you’ll need to add a payment method to cover postage.
